tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don zur bkol bzhugs so//

༈ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la rgyud snod rung du bya phyir thun mong sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi rim pa la lnga ste/ thog mar skyabs 'gro ni/ skyabs yul gsal btab ste lus ngag yid gsum 'jug pa cig bsgril gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la= /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// de ltar tshogs zhing rnams la blo gtad ling skyur gyis skyabs 'gro ci nus bya zhing*/ mthar/ bla ma dkon mchog rin po che rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog / de nas gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la blos gzhi btang nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad bde ba ltar snang nyi tshe ba'i ngang nas sdug bsngal mtha' med khor mo yug tu spyod bzhin pa la yid skyo shas dang bcas smon 'jug gi sems bskyed pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi'i don bsgom pa rang rgyud la ci 'drer bya zhing ngag tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya'o// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig gsum pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam pa ra spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri ya/ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla zhing*/ sngags don dang mthun par gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng zhal nang bstan de las bdud rtsi babs sku gang rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar spros sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha rnams las bdud rtsi 'o rgyun ltar babs rang lus shel bum gang ba ltar/

nad gdon bag chags dri ma phyir lud par dmigs nas mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste rang la thim/ gnas lugs bskyang*/ bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ dngos 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa 'di skabs dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas la rten 'byung gi ched du gtsor bton dgos pas/ dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i drung*/ mchod rdzas gang 'byor tshar du dngar ba dang*/ maṇ+ḍal rgyu rin po che las grub pa sogs gang rnyed dang*/ dri bzang gi chu dang*/ 'bru sna la sogs pa bcas 'du bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal med khang dang skyabs yul tshogs zhing rnams sngar ltar dmigs la/ bdag gzhan sems can gyi lus zhing gi rdul snyed sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// ces dang*/ gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi// de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas// mig skyon med rnams rol bar bcas pas steng du ni// blta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas phyag bya/ khyod ni ma dang khyod ni pha ste khyod ni 'gro ba'i bla ma khyod ni gnyen dang grogs bzang po// khyod ni mgon po khyod ni byed po phan dang sdig 'phrog khyod ni go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa yang*// khyod ni 'ba' zhig gnas dang khyod ni yon tan mchog gi gnas te skyon rnams bcom pa khyod nyid do// khyod ni dman pa rnams kyi mgon dang yid bzhin nor bu rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod la bdag skyabs mchi//

zhes pa'am/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pas skyabs 'gro bya/ de nas lus kyi las su maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu dgod/ yid kyi dmigs pa/ 'og gzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i gling bzhi ri rab khor yug dang bcas pa/ steng phyogs srid pa'i rtse mo man chad khams gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa lha dang mi'i dngos po bzang la gya nom pas go mtshams med cing phyur bur bkang ste bla ma dkon mchog rnams la phul/ de'i rjes su bdag myur du sangs rgyas thob pa dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ de dag gi skabs ngag tu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng du/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/ hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nub ba lang spyod/ sgra gcan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ dus me/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa gang yang ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum dus gsum dge tshogs bcas// rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis dmigs nas bla ma dkon mchog rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa'am/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog

/ ces brjod/ tshul des maṇ+ḍal ci nus su dbul/ ngo bo skyong zhing dge bsngo sogs bya'o// lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gnas khang dag pa'i zhing du gsal ba'i dbus su/ seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bzung ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ rang la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi tshogs mtha' yas pa 'phro ba'i sku can/ mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan rang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa blos phul te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// sdig pa bshags so// dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul lo// mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs so// dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bgyi'o// skyabs su mchi'o// byang chub tu sems bskyed do// bla na med pa'i lam bsten par bgyi'o// bdag la thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// drin chen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mnyam med bka' drin can gyi thugs rjes gzigs// 'di phyi bar do kun tu byin gyis rlobs// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag rtse gcig sgrub pa nus par= sgrub pa la bar chad mi 'byung bar= sgrub pa snying po nyams su longs par= sgrub pa rab kyi mthar phyin par= byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'byongs par=

zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob par= nyams myong dang rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar= zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa mthar phyin par= phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bla ma'i sku'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥrnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhugs/ oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing nag 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ hoḥlas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ chags rtog gi bag chags dag bzhi pa ye shes rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs zhugs/ slar yang mos gus dung pa dang yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams bla ma nyid la thim/ de nyid shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rang gi spyi bor byon/ 'od zer bdud rtsi'i tshul du zhu ste rang la thim/ bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngang la cung zad mnyam par gzhag dge bsngo sogs bya'o/ /sngags lam gyi nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad bla ma'i byin rlabs kho na las lam du byed dgos pas grub gnyis kyi rtsa ba mchog ste gal che'o// de nas thun mong min pa'i sngon 'gro la rdzogs rim gyi rten bskyed pa'i rim pa lhan skyes nyid bsngags pas de'i bsgom tshul ni/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dus 'khor lhan skyes su gyur pa ni/

'byung bzhi ri rab pad zla nyi ma sgra gcan rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon pa dkar po bskums pas dbang phyug dkar po dang*/ g.yas pa dmar po brkyangs pas 'dod lha dmar po'i snying gar mnan pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas dbu la brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag sor rnams kha dog lnga pa dang*/ sor tshigs rnams kha dog gsum pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan cing*/ me ri kha dog sna lnga pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can no// de la 'khyud pa'i sna tshogs yum sku mdog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab dang sbyor ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing*/ dbu skra phyed grol ba'o// dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gsang gnas su swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs su gyur/ de thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ lha sku gsal stong de la ci nus su mnyam par gzhag de ltar bsam zhing sngags bzla ba ni/ oṃ haṃk+ṣamalawaraya swāhā/ ci nus dang*/ mthar thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ lha sku 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang du sbyang*/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ de nas dben gsum ltos med bzhi ldan dang*/ dngos gzhi/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su bral dang ting nge 'dzin// sbyor ba yan lag drug tu 'dod// de dag ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'dod don gsol gdab ni/

lha bde gshegs snying po'i bka' drin gyis// yid rnam rtog 'gyu ba so sor bcad// nyams 'od gsal rtags bcu rdzogs gyur nas// lam sor sdud 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// lha bde gshegs snying= /yid rlung sems ngag rnams mi g.yo zhing*// nyams shes rab rtog spyod dga' bde 'phel// lam bsam gtan 'byongs par= /lha bde gshegs snying= /rtsa ro rkyang rlung bcu dbu mar tshud// nyams gtum mo 'bar bas haṃ yig zhu// lam srog rtsol 'byongs par= /lha bde gshegs= /khams 'jig med thig le dpral bar brtan// nyams zhu bde 'gyur med rgyud la skyes// lam 'dzin pa 'byongs= /lha bde gshegs= /lus rtsa 'dab bde chen thig les gang*// nyams phyag rgya gsum la mnga' brnyes pas// lam rjes dran 'byongs= /lha bde gshegs= /rtsa 'khor lo drug po bde bas gang*// nyams spros pa med la dbang 'byor ba'i// lam ting 'dzin 'byongs= /lha bde gshegs= /lus byed bcings gnad dang ma bral zhing*// chos ma nor man ngag zab mo yis// lam sbyor drug 'byongs= /

de nas bsngo ba ni/ chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// dus gsum bsags dang rtogs pa yis// 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun// sku lnga yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas myur thob shog / smon lam ni/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med dus kyi 'khor lo ston// bla ma la gus snying brtser ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam za can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de las byung ba'i dge ba'i 'od zer gyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i blo yi mun bsal nas// bde chen thar ba'i lam la 'god pa dang*// kun khyab bde chen snying po mngon gyur shog / bkra shis ni/ skyabs gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i dge legs dang*// don dam rtag brtan bde ba'i phun tshogs kyis// nges don snying po'i rgyud rgyal dus 'khor lo'i// phrin las dar zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
